claude.label: Claude Code
claude.notes: Fresh Claude Code session. Resume: vibelaunch claude-resume (or claude -c). Add flags via presets.local.json args.

claude-resume.label: Claude Code (resume)
claude-resume.notes: Continues the most recent Claude Code session (-c). Same cwd as claude preset.

codex.label: Codex (config cwd)
codex.notes: Interactive Codex TUI at config cwd (defaults.json cwd / your defaults.local.json).

codex-workspace.label: Codex -> example workspace
codex-workspace.notes: Codex in the configured example workspace. Override workspaces.default in defaults.local.json.

cmd-scroll-test.label: cmd.exe scrollback test
cmd-scroll-test.notes: Diagnostic normal-buffer shell. At prompt: for /L %i in (1,1,100) do @echo line %i - then scroll with keypad/PC to verify rows depth.

hermes-vk.label: Hermes (VibeKeys)
hermes-vk.notes: Auto: WSL if profile wsl.enabled + hermes in WSL, else Windows PATH. Override: vibelaunch hermes wsl | vibelaunch hermes windows.

hermes-vk-wsl.label: Hermes (VibeKeys, WSL)
hermes-vk-wsl.notes: Force WSL even when Hermes is also on Windows PATH. Requires wsl.user.

hermes-vk-win.label: Hermes (VibeKeys, Windows)
hermes-vk-win.notes: Force native Windows Hermes (Hermes Desktop / CLI on PATH). No WSL.

hermes-codex-workspace.label: Hermes + Codex model (WSL)
hermes-codex-workspace.notes: WSL Hermes with Codex model at spawn (-m openai-codex/gpt-5.4). Change model in spawn or use /model inside chat.

hermes-codex-workspace-win.label: Hermes + Codex model (Windows)
spawn: set HERMES_VIBEKEYS_SESSION=1&& hermes chat --skills vibekeys-hermes -m openai-codex/gpt-5.4
hermes-codex-workspace-win.notes: Windows Hermes with Codex model at spawn. WSL Codex auth is separate from Windows user config.

openclaw-vk.label: OpenClaw TUI (vibekeys session)
openclaw-vk.notes: WSL only (no native Windows OpenClaw companion yet). --session vibekeys avoids main-session heartbeat spam.

openclaw-tui.label: OpenClaw TUI (main session)
openclaw-tui.notes: WSL gateway main session (no --session). Heartbeat/status polls may appear on small screens; prefer openclaw-vk for keypad.

openclaw-cursor-workspace.label: OpenClaw -> Cursor ACP
openclaw-cursor-workspace.notes: ACP harness spawn at launch via --message. Requires your OpenClaw ACP config (cursor harness, cwd, auth).

openclaw-codex-workspace.label: OpenClaw -> Codex ACP
openclaw-codex-workspace.notes: ACP harness id codex per OpenClaw agents docs. Requires local ACP harness + Codex auth in WSL.

hermes-acp-cursor.label: Hermes -> Cursor ACP (drop-in)
hermes-acp-cursor.notes: Hermes ACP *client* drop-in to a live Cursor session. Spawns persistent shell; type prompts, 'exit' quits. Requires Cursor Pro `agent` auth. Verified 2026-07-12.

hermes-acp-claude.label: Hermes -> Claude Code ACP (drop-in)
hermes-acp-claude.notes: Hermes ACP *client* drop-in to Claude Code via npx @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp. Requires Node + Claude Pro auth. Verified 2026-07-12.

hermes-acp-codex.label: Hermes -> Codex ACP (drop-in)
hermes-acp-codex.notes: Hermes ACP *client* drop-in to Codex via npx @zed-industries/codex-acp. Requires Node + Codex ChatGPT auth (codex login). NOTE: adapter + handshake verified 2026-07-12; if prompt 401s, run `codex login` (token can be invalidated).
